title: Consultation Fee Rate by Construction Stage of the Home — Design Studio Selections
content:
The build stage rate of a design consultation fee on a Design Studio Selections file is set by the calendar days from the construction start date of the Home Purchase Agreement the file serves to the date of the billed appointment.

| Billed appointment held | Build stage rate |
|---|---|
| 30 days or more after construction started | 150 percent |
| On or after the construction start date, but fewer than 30 days after it | 125 percent |
| Before construction started, or on an agreement where construction has not started | 100 percent |

**Records read.** The construction start date shown on the Home Purchase Agreement (absent while construction has not started) and the date of the billed appointment on the design ledger.

**Boundary cases** (hypothetical construction start date 2026-05-04)

| Billed appointment date | Days after construction start | Build stage rate |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-03 | Before the start | 100 percent |
| 2026-05-04 | 0 | 125 percent |
| 2026-06-02 | 29 | 125 percent |
| 2026-06-03 | 30 | 150 percent |
